properties.name: auto_scroll
properties.comment: Whether scroll bars appear when the content exceeds the client area (AutoScroll).

table.description: Whether scroll bars appear when content exceeds the client area.

hand: written updates the scroll state, resets the position when turned off and reports a moved position; TextBox and RichTextBox react through on_auto_scroll_changed (study 15.3)

properties.name: auto_scroll_margin
properties.comment: Logical space kept around the content when scrolling; nonnegative (AutoScrollMargin).

table.description: Logical space kept around the content when scrolling; nonnegative.

hand: written touches only while auto scroll is on

properties.name: auto_scroll_min_size
properties.comment: Smallest logical content size scrolling allows for; nonnegative (AutoScrollMinSize).

table.description: Smallest logical content size scrolling allows for; nonnegative.

hand: written turns auto scroll on, as Windows Forms' setter writes AutoScroll

properties.name: auto_scroll_position
properties.comment: The scrolled content's offset, negated as Windows Forms reports it (AutoScrollPosition); a write scrolls to the given position, clamped at zero.

table.description: The scrolled content's offset, negated as Windows Forms reports it.

hand: a view over the scroll position: the write scrolls

properties.name: wheel_scrolls
properties.comment: Whether a wheel turn over the control, or bubbling unhandled from a descendant, scrolls the control natively; false leaves the wheel to the consumer (a compatibility layer's OnMouseWheel).

table.description: Whether an unhandled wheel turn scrolls the control natively.

hand: handle_wheel reads it at each wheel turn; written has nothing to touch

not_properties.name: hscroll, vscroll
not_properties.reason: views of the scroll bars' visibility, kept with the bars (ScrollProperties)
